$Comment: Percent bonus to every reputation gain the carrier earns, in whole percent points (10 is +10%). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat (Additive on the Max); ziggfreed-common multiplies each positive gain (a kill, a quest's or contract's reputation reward, anything that pays standing) by 1 + this plus the reputation's own ReputationGain_<Id>, before the reputation's Cap, and never touches a loss. A pack that wants gear to speed one reputation alone ships its own ReputationGain_<Id>.json in this shape, <Id> spelled as its ReputationGroup file is named. Base 0, so an unmodified player earns the amount written; Min -100, so a subtractive modifier can at most shrink a gain to 1.
